benchmark_name: Pandey & Kumar (2025) Section 4.5 Plate with Off-Axis Hole (Case 2)

restart_audit.technical_reason: In the bitwise frozen UEL f42_mixed_uel.for, SV_H_COMMITTED and SV_H_TRIAL initialization in Fortran COMMON blocks is strictly guarded at line 249 by IF (KSTEP .EQ. 1 .AND. KINC .LE. 1). When an Abaqus restart analysis begins at Step 2 (KSTEP=2), this block is bypassed, while UEXTERNALDB(LOP=0) at lines 88-101 explicitly zeroes out all SV_H_COMMITTED arrays. Consequently, history fields remain 0.0D0 in memory across all elements, destroying irreversibility and causing unphysical crack healing. Because modifying the frozen production UEL is strictly prohibited by governance, full rerun on the unchanged 23,965-element mesh is the sole technically valid and reproducible continuation route.
affected_common_blocks: COMMON /CB_STATE_TRANS/ SV_PHASE_COMMITTED, SV_PHASE_TRIAL, SV_H_COMMITTED, SV_H_TRIAL, SV_E_FRAC, SV_E_ELAS, SV_PSI_F, SV_PSI_E

solver_parameters.parameter_diff_summary: Verified exact byte-level diff: strictly 1 line modified (line 96209). Initial increment is positive 0.002 in both files; only min_increment changes from 1.0e-8 to 1.0e-11. Max increment (0.002), max increments (20000), boundary conditions, material constants, geometry, and mesh are 100% bitwise preserved. Zero artificial damping, zero modified tolerances.

reference_benchmarks.reconciliation_note: Reconciled peak force provenance: 0.57168 kN is the authentic peak force of the Case 2 adapted fracture simulation (Job 1423271); 0.5488 kN belongs to the unadapted coarse pre-analysis. The 75% load drop criterion evaluates strictly against 0.57168 kN.

resource_request.resource_basis: Empirical solver performance from Job 1423271 established 252 converged increments in 2,472s wallclock (1,690s CPU) on 1 core with peak memory < 2 GB. Estimating completion of remaining post-peak increments at 3,600-5,400s, a 3-hour (10,800s) allocation with 8 GB RAM in queue normal_imfdfkmq provides a bounded 2x-3x safety envelope without overloading cluster resources.

condition_1_cutbacks.action: Daemon polls .sta every 5s; terminates Abaqus solver process via 'abaqus terminate' if consecutive cutbacks reach 50.

condition_2_rate_stagnation.threshold: Delta uy < 1.0e-7 mm across 10 consecutive increments
condition_2_rate_stagnation.action: Classification rejected as STAGNATED if displacement advance rate fails threshold.

condition_3_walltime.action: PBS automatically terminates job upon reaching walltime ceiling.

condition_4_damage_bounds.action: Classification rejected as UNPHYSICAL_DAMAGE if any integration point violates bounds.

gate_2_damage_bounds.criterion: 0 <= d <= 1.0004 across all elements and frames

gate_3_pointwise_damage_irreversibility.description: Strict pointwise damage irreversibility across all 23,965 physical elements and all consecutive converged increment pairs.

gate_4_pointwise_history_monotonicity.description: Strict pointwise history variable monotonicity across all elements and consecutive increments.

gate_5_secondary_propagation.description: Secondary crack extension through the distal ligament.

gate_6_load_drop.criterion: F_final <= 0.14292 kN (>= 75% load drop relative to F_max = 0.57168 kN)

gate_7_resolution_classification.criterion: Explicit reporting of secondary front resolution as PARTIAL vs FULL vs SPATIALLY_QUALIFIED

checkpoint_parity_hypotheses.hypothesis_1_parity: At increment 252 (predecessor termination point), the full rerun will match Job 1423271 within strict tolerances: global force delta <= 0.01%, displacement delta <= 1.0e-6 mm, peak force delta <= 0.01%.
checkpoint_parity_hypotheses.hypothesis_2_continuation: Relaxing min_increment from 1.0e-8 to 1.0e-11 provides the cutback resolution needed to overcome the DOF 3 damage correction divergence at Node 8056 and continue fracture propagation through the secondary ligament.
